mentions.name: TabNews 2025 Data Analysis Infographic
mentions.description: This project crawls and analyzes 6,380 posts from TabNews, a Brazilian developer community, and presents the findings as an interactive infographic built with pure HTML/CSS (scraping done in Python, no JS frameworks). It surfaces insights such as AI/ML topics dominating about 50% of discussions, Monday 8am being the best time to post, and longer titles (100+ characters) performing better.
